text:
sam: PTAL on https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1234 — addressed last round of comments. Migration updated for zero-downtime: added backfill step, idempotent DDL, and a feature-flag gate. Backfill script at tools/db/backfill.py. I left commits intact (no squash). Need one approval to schedule canary today.

olivia: Taking a look now, running the staging smoke.

raj: Quick nit: can we gate the table creation behind the feature flag check too? also prefer keeping history (no squash) so we can bisect if needed.

sam: good call — added the flag check to the create_table path and pushed a tiny fix. left history as-is. thanks.

mike: staging smoke reports 3/5 endpoints OK, /inference is failing with `IndexError: missing index build` in logs. did we forget to run index build in the deploy steps?

olivia: try running `./tools/db/build_indexes.sh` on staging and then `./scripts/smoke --route=/inference`. did that locally and it fixed the same failure.

sam: kicked a new staging deploy with index build step included, CI passed. Can someone +1 so I can schedule canary at 16:00 UTC? @raj @olivia

raj: :thumbsup: looks fine to me, leaving final +1 to olivia after smoke confirmation.

olivia: +1 from me, smoke is green on staging after the rebuild. go for canary. :party-parrot:

ci-bot: deploy scheduled to canary at 1600 UTC. build: r-2026-03-20-1350.

sam: Thanks — I'll monitor logs and metric dashboards for 30m. will post back if anything odd; will roll back on error.

olivia: awesome, ping if you want eyes on the logs.

sam: will do, thanks all.
